plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Social Studies Education Composite (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Social Studies Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Social Studies Education (Campus)', last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026 (the workbook Index lists Online as N/A for this program). Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S. with Licensure: the catalog prints 'Total Credits, BS Degree with Licensure: 120' (BA with Licensure: 132), the map totals exactly 120 (15/16/15/15/16/16/15/12), and the map's own note states students electing the Bachelor of Arts will take 16 credits of one foreign language, not included in the map. The map exercises the full catalog curriculum: History 18 (HIST 1500/1510/2700/2710/3870 plus the Underrepresented Community slot, whose 17 catalog options are carried on the slot), Social Studies 45 (Anthropology slot — the catalog's Anthropology block is ANTH 1010 alone; ECON 2010 plus the Economics slot, ECON 2020 or ECON 3840; GEOG 1000/1300; two Political Science slots — the catalog's Political Science block (6 credits) is two 'complete one of the following' pairs (POLS 3010 or POLS 3030; POLS 1100 or POLS 3510); the map prints two generic Political Science slots, one for each pair.; PSY 1010 plus the Psychology slot, PSY 3210 or PSY 3220; the Sociology slot, SOC 1010 or SOC 1020; and the map's 'Major Upper-division Elective' row, recorded as exercising the catalog's Social Studies Elective block with its full option list), Teaching License 12 (SOSC 4900, SOSC 4980), and Professional Education (EDUC 2100/2200/2400, SPED 2010, SCED 3180, SCED 3720, SCED 3570, SCED 3590, EDUC 4930). The catalog's generic licensure slots ('Academic 3900/4900 - Methods Course(s)', 'Academic 4980 - Student Teaching') are exercised through SOSC 4900 and SOSC 4980, which the catalog footnote names as this major's methods and student-teaching courses. SCED 3180 is catalogued at 2-3 credits and recorded at the map's 2. The map carries a Fall Year 3 banner, 'Apply to College of Education Teacher Preparation Program'. All major courses must be passed with a C- or better per the catalog; EDUC 2100, EDUC 2200 and SPED 2010 must be completed with a grade of C or better before admission to the teacher preparation program per the catalog.
